evidence.V1: Ladder-back chair with ball finials reads clearly from front, three-quarter and silhouette; top view reads via seat square + finial-capped back rail.
evidence.V2: Big (seat, back posts), medium (top rail, three slats, legs/stretchers), small (gold ball finials, value-shifted slats) hierarchy is clear.
evidence.V3: Ladder back and finials give character, but every member is a straight square-section box with no taper, splay or curve, so the proportions read partly as stiff primitives.
evidence.V4: Consistent small chamfers catch light along seat edge, posts, top rail and slats in the back and seat close-ups.
evidence.V5: Seat, back and finial close-ups show clean shading with no pinches, seams or z-fighting; X symmetry 0.0, top rail seated on posts.
evidence.V6: One wood hue in three values (light slats/seat, mid frame, dark top rail) plus gold finials; disciplined.
evidence.V8: Single vertex-coloured wood hue, gold fittings, chamfered edges match the furniture kit.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre, Seat note; A1-A18 pass.

top_fixes: Taper the legs toward the feet and give the back posts a slight backward rake for a more stylised, less boxy read
Add a gentle curve or dish to the top rail / seat front edge
Slightly enlarge or neck the finials so they read as turned knobs rather than balls on posts
